proof.convergenceClaim: Finite asymptotic enclosure only. The infinite moment series is not claimed to converge.
proof.remainder: After N terms, the sign is (-1)^N and the absolute remainder is at most the positive N-th term. Taylor remainder for (1+t)^(-a) has this sign and is bounded by (a)_N*t^N/N! for all t>=0; integrate against the complete positive gamma density.
proof.zeroParameterPolicy: Generic h=0 or z=0 means the analytic continuous extension of normalized coefficients. Actual-source h and z below are strictly positive and are never replaced.

proof.chartIdentity: X=R^2/(2s), eta=Z/s^(1/2-h), s-Z^2*s^(2h)=T. Since s>0, ordinary real exponential power rules give 2*(1-eta^2)/X=4*(s-Z^2*s^(2h))/R^2=4T/R^2 throughout the smooth source chart. Equality on a neighborhood identifies all displayed slow derivatives; this is an analytic chart identity, not an evaluated inverse-root approximation.
proof.everyFiniteOrderBound: For every fixed integer j>=0 and z>=0, |H^(j)(z)| <= (h)_j*(1+h)_j <= j!*(j+1)! when 0<h<1. At z=0 use the same right derivatives and continuous extension. Only j<=2 source slow-jet roots and numerical enclosures are executed here.
proof.gammaAndDerivatives: Gamma density exp(-v)*v^h/Gamma(1+h) has moment (1+h)_j. Every fixed heat argument derivative is dominated by (h)_j*exp(-v)*v^(h+j)/Gamma(1+h); this dominates the complete improper interval and all compact nonnegative argument ranges.
